claims.text: The Cathédrale Notre-Dame de Paris is an iconic Early Gothic masterpiece dedicated to the Virgin Mary.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Its ambitious construction began in 1163 and was not fully completed until the 14th century.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: The cathedral famously inspired Victor Hugo's celebrated novel, which was published in 1831 and helped shape its modern history.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Before tragedy struck, it was the most visited monument in Europe, drawing some 13 to 14 million people every single year.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: On 15 April 2019, a devastating fire destroyed the cathedral's historic spire and its entire wooden roof structure.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Following a massive and complex restoration effort, this resilient symbol of France proudly reopened to the public in December 2024.
claims.subject: self
